name: openpixo/watercolor-storybook
title: Watercolor storybook
description: Translucent washes and gentle pencil contours for quiet, story-led adventures.

description_i18n.en: Translucent washes and gentle pencil contours for quiet, story-led adventures.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 以透明水色和轻柔铅笔轮廓，表现安静、叙事驱动的冒险世界。

examples.title: Meadow campsite
examples.prompt: Generate a quiet meadow campsite illustration using the watercolor-storybook art style, with a small canvas tent, a kettle and wildflowers beside a narrow stream. Leave airy space around the scene.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 watercolor-storybook 美术风格生成安静的草地营地插画：小帆布帐篷、水壶和溪边野花。场景周围保留通透留白。

examples.title: Woodland companions
examples.prompt: Create two original woodland companion portraits using the watercolor-storybook art style: a curious mouse with a scarf and a patient tortoise with a leaf satchel. Match their paper texture and soft pencil contours.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 watercolor-storybook 美术风格制作两张原创林间伙伴肖像：围围巾的好奇小鼠、背叶片挎包的耐心乌龟。统一纸张质感和柔和铅笔轮廓。

style.prompt: Watercolor storybook game illustration with translucent layered washes, softly pooled pigment at edges and subtle cold-press paper grain. Gentle pencil contours, simplified friendly forms and airy negative space. Use muted botanical colors with warm ochre accents; keep the focal subject clearly separated from softer surrounding washes and avoid muddy overpainting.
style.negativePrompt: photorealism, glossy digital rendering, thick black contours, hard cel shadows, neon colors, dense texture, muddy opaque paint, vector-perfect edges, text, signature, watermark

constraints.outline: Light broken pencil contours; let watercolor edges remain visible.
